production_environment: Fly.io app '10bonds', region cdg, always on (min_machines_running 1, auto_stop off), 1024 MB, health /api/health and /api/ready (fly.toml). Read from repository files on 06 Nov 2026; NOT live-checked (no production or Render/Fly credentials in this environment).
release_restrictions: HOLD (CLAUDE.md): no workflow runs on push to claude/** or session branches
HOLD: draft PRs do not run CI; CI starts when marked ready
HOLD: only nightly-live-check may e-mail Livio
RULE ZERO: never ask Livio to do what a tool can do
Lenovo: only qwen3:8b with keep_alive; dates like 03 Nov 2026
data_sensitivity: Public market and bond data; accounts database exists (ACCOUNTS_DATABASE_URL): treat user data as sensitive
deployment_process: CLAUDE.md: the owning session runs 'fly deploy' after merge; deploy.yml is manual fallback (workflow_dispatch) and requires the CI workflow to pass first. Not performed under AEOS without written approval.
rollback_process: One click: Actions 'Roll back to the previous release' (rollback.yml, workflow_dispatch) runs scripts/fly-rollback.sh, putting the previous image back on Fly; the deploy workflow runs the same script itself when post-deploy checks fail.
